issue: S22 photos unavailable until offline download was deleted
diagnosis: Android File.toURI emits file:/ paths unsupported by Capacitor convertFileSrc, which accepts file:// paths
fix: Android emits Uri.fromFile; shared client normalizes legacy file:/ paths and retries original remote image on local cache error without a retry loop
hub: delegated to Jave; synchronization not verified here

changes: continue until the existing four-minute time limit instead of stopping every 25 photos
retry IO failures at most three times with WorkManager backoff
system-interrupted workers preserve the download instead of reporting a terminal failure
unavailable individual photos do not block the other photos; incomplete downloads remain incomplete and are retried
